northStar: Phase1 acceptance = morning report in Russian; Phase2 = RU/AZ/EN documents via adapter

cases.title: GigaAM-v3 ONNX int8 primary STT transcribes Russian fixture
cases.criterion: Primary STT engine is GigaAM-v3 ONNX int8 (MIT); Russian speech fixture yields non-empty transcript containing expected tokens

cases.title: faster-whisper int8 fallback engages when primary unavailable
cases.criterion: With primary forced unavailable, fallback STT is faster-whisper int8 and still returns Russian transcript

cases.title: Silero VAD distinguishes speech vs silence
cases.criterion: Silero VAD marks speech fixture as speech and silence fixture as non-speech

cases.title: Silero TTS v5_4_ru synthesizes Russian morning-report line
cases.criterion: TTS model id is v5_4_ru; input Russian sentence produces non-empty wav/pcm audio bytes

cases.title: Push-to-talk path: audio in to text out via FastAPI
cases.criterion: POST push-to-talk endpoint accepts short wav and returns text; wake-word path not required

cases.title: Adapter is not a brain (no scheduler / task authority)
cases.criterion: Health/metadata advertises adapter-only; no cron, no exec-graph writes, no second task queue

cases.title: atlas-cli can call local voice adapter HTTP contract
cases.criterion: Documented CLI or client module reaches local FastAPI base URL and parses JSON transcript envelope

cases.title: Morning report Russian round-trip (north-star acceptance)
cases.criterion: Sample morning-report Russian text -> TTS -> STT recovers meaning-equivalent Russian (human or CER threshold TBD)

cases.title: Cloud fallback order Riva/NIM then Azure F0; sensitive stays local
cases.criterion: Non-sensitive path may use NVIDIA Riva/NIM then Azure Speech F0; sensitive flag forces local-only and never uploads audio

cases.title: Voice stack fits RTX 5060 8GB without OOM
cases.criterion: Loading declared voice models alone does not OOM on 8GB; peak VRAM recorded in evidence

cases.title: Python 3.12 venv required (reject 3.14 as primary)
cases.criterion: Documents adapter runtime is Python 3.12.x; harness fails closed if only 3.14+ without 3.12

cases.title: PaddleOCR-VL 1.6 HF Transformers backend loads
cases.criterion: PaddleOCR-VL 1.6 via HF Transformers initializes and OCRs a RU fixture page

cases.title: PP-StructureV3 extracts table from fixture
cases.criterion: Table fixture yields structured rows/columns (not empty) via PP-StructureV3

cases.title: Tesseract rus+aze+eng CPU fallback works
cases.criterion: With primary OCR forced down, Tesseract with rus+aze+eng returns text for multilingual fixture

cases.title: Azerbaijani diacritics preserved (EasyOCR #357 guard)
cases.criterion: AZ fixture with ə/ö/ğ/ş/ç/ü is not mangled relative to gold; EasyOCR must not be the engine

cases.title: Documents adapter matches Voice adapter pattern
cases.criterion: FastAPI sidecar + atlas-cli client; no own scheduler/brain

cases.title: Combined Voice+Documents disk budget ~5GB
cases.criterion: Measured on-disk model/runtime assets for both phases ≤ ~5GB (or CEO-approved override receipt)

cases.title: Voice+OCR VRAM contention fail-closed on 8GB
cases.criterion: Simultaneous load either serialises or refuses with clear error; no silent dual-OOM on RTX 5060 8GB
